instructions_to_main_agent: This is a mobile app UI built with React.js + Tailwind (likely wrapped in a WebView/Capacitor/PWA since 'work on iOS and Android in parallel' was requested). Use mobile-first responsive design constraints (e.g., max-w-md mx-auto for screens, bottom safe areas for mobile).
Use Framer Motion for screen transitions, micro-interactions on buttons, and stagger animations for bento grids.
Implement the 'Glassmorphism' surface strategy on sticky headers, bottom navigation, and paywall overlays to create depth.
Do NOT use pure #000000. Use the defined #040B08 (Deep Emerald/Obsidian mix) as the absolute base to make the UI feel alive and premium.
Data-testid attributes MUST be added to all interactive elements for testing.
For the AI meal generation, use a loading state that incorporates subtle pulsing glows (emerald-500/20) to make it feel 'intelligent' and premium.
Ensure all components have 'rounded-2xl' or 'rounded-3xl' to match the premium, modern aesthetic.
Always rely on optical alignment, and provide ample spacing (`gap-4` or `gap-6` between mobile sections) for breathing room.
